races.race_title: British EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)

runners.spotlight_comment: 130,000euros yearling, 400,000gns 2yo breeze-ups; by No Nay Never; first foal; dam unplaced 6f/1m 2yo, sister to 7f 2yo Group 3 winner Aktabantay, half-sister to winners Baydar (smart 1m-1m2f) and Reina Madre (7f Group 3), out of 1m2f Listed winner; takes on males on debut but could still have a big say.
runners.diomed_comment: 400,000gns 2yo breeze-ups; takes on males on debut but could still have a big say

runners.spotlight_comment: Strong in the market at 5-2 when runner-up on debut at Ascot (6f, good) this month, having made the running; the winner has followed up and he sets a useful standard for the rest to aim at.
runners.diomed_comment: 5-2 when runner-up on debut at Ascot; winner has followed up; sets a useful standard

runners.spotlight_comment: £30,000 yearling, 240,000gns 2yo breeze-ups; tenth foal; half-brother to four winners notably Bowland Park (7f-1m2f including 2yo; RPR 93); dam 6f 2yo Group 3 winner; last month's purchase price catches the eye and he could play a leading role on debut.
runners.diomed_comment: Went for 240,000gns at the breeze-ups last month and could play a leading role on debut

runners.owner: Lord Lloyd Webber & W S Farish
runners.spotlight_comment: Second foal; No Nay Never half-sister to 7f AW winner Champion Again Ole (RPR 86); dam 6f winner (including 2yo/Group 2), from talented family; takes on males and she's likely to improve for this debut run.
runners.diomed_comment: Dam 6f winner (including 2yo/Group 2); takes on males and likely to improve for this debut

runners.spotlight_comment: 65,000euros foal, 80,000euros yearling; sixth foal; Blackbeard half-brother to three winners notably Eternal Hope (1m1f-1m4f including US turf Grade 2); dam 7f AW 2yo winner (79), half-sister to 7f-1m2f Group 1 winner Rio De La Plata; trainer's 2yos have been going very well; chance on debut.
runners.diomed_comment: 80,000euros yearling; half-brother to three winners; yard's 2yos have been going very well

runners.spotlight_comment: 82,000gns foal, 42,000gns yearling; first foal; dam German 1m 2yo winner, half-sister to winners Grocer Jack (German/Italian 1m2f Group 3) and Ghislaine (German 7f Listed), out of German 1m3f Group 3 winner; this Lucky Vega newcomer is one to be interested in if strong in the betting.
runners.diomed_comment: 42,000gns yearling; first foal; dam German 1m 2yo winner; betting could be informative

runners.spotlight_comment: 42,000euros foal, 100,000gns yearling; first foal; dam 5f winner (RPR 77), closely related to 7f 2yo winner Charged Up, half-sister to 9.4f/1m2f winner Glorious Caesar, out of 7f 2yo Listed winner; trainer has 28% strike-rate with 2yos here in last five years; this Havana Grey newcomer is respected.
runners.diomed_comment: Debut; 100,000gns yearling; trainer has 28% strike-rate with 2yos here in last five years

runners.spotlight_comment: £36,000 yearling, £90,000 2yo breeze-ups; first foal; dam unraced half-sister to three winners including Legionario (1m Listed); trainer has already unearthed some useful 2yos and this Starman newcomer could be a contender.
runners.diomed_comment: Trainer has already unearthed some useful 2yos; this Starman newcomer could be a contender

runners.spotlight_comment: 130,000euros yearling; sixth foal; No Nay Never brother to winners Frescobaldi (Listed-placed 7f 2yo; RPR 94) and How Lovely (5f/6f including 2yo; 82), half-brother to US 5.5f turf 2yo winner Kodikova; dam placed 7f-8.5f (inc 2yo Listed); could give a good account on debut.
runners.diomed_comment: 130,000euros yearling; useful pedigree and could give a good account on debut

runners.spotlight_comment: 150,000gns yearling who is a half-brother to six winners but he needs to produce considerably more than he's managed on his first two starts.
runners.diomed_comment: Half-brother to six winners but has to produce considerably more than he's managed so far

runners.spotlight_comment: 62,000euros foal, 75,000euros yearling; fifth foal; Blackbeard half-brother to 6f AW winner Dyed In The Wool (RPR 74); dam 5f 2yo winner (76), half-sister to four winners out of US 6f stakes winner; not ruled out on debut but he may well improve for the outing.
runners.diomed_comment: Half-brother to 6f AW winner Dyed In The Wool (RPR 74); may improve for this debut outing
